name: Conqueror
source:
This is it. It's the final battle. Kojika's army has struggled through a long campaign to get here, and now Kojika is finally about to overcome the greatest threat: Staghart the Conqueror, a cruel tyrant who has brought despair to his own country in the pursuit of power. But what they don't tell you about war is... what happens next?

In this new world, Kojika has a hard time coming to terms with a post-war society, which is made even more difficult when his former nemesis shows up, having lost everything. Kojika soon realizes they must join sides in order to defeat a greater threat. Can Kojika and Staghart ever reconcile their differences?

[From [url=https://gatrgroh.itch.io/conqueror]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
就是这样。这是最后的战斗。小鹿的军队经过漫长的征战才到达这里，现在小鹿终于要克服最大的威胁：征服者斯塔格哈特，一个残酷的暴君，在追求权力的过程中给自己的国家带来了绝望。但他们没有告诉你关于战争的是……接下来会发生什么？

在这个新世界中，小鹿很难适应战后社会，而当他失去一切的前对手出现时，情况变得更加困难。小鹿很快意识到他们必须联合起来才能击败更大的威胁。小鹿和斯塔格特能调和他们之间的分歧吗？

[来自[url=https://gatrgroh.itch.io/conqueror]Itch.io[/url]]
